title: The Tunnel Echo
title_options: Follow the Dust, Ignore the Arrow

voice.status: Approved narrator; Liam preferred. Preserve native pitch/tempo. No audio generated. Lara unavailable; not substituted or claimed auditioned.
voice.character_casting: Provisional Liam/Jason and Laura/Lucia only where dialogue is present; narrator approval does not approve character acting.

timeline: Linear: eight causal beats in one incident.
pov: Third person limited to Jason and Lucia; no unseen antagonist knowledge.
delivery: Dialogue-led: quoted lines alternate named speakers; Liam as provisional Jason and Laura as provisional Lucia. Character casting not audition-approved. No third voice.
hook: Jason said, The case is behind that wall. Lucia said, Why does your knock echo from above?
alternative_hooks: Jason heard rock. Lucia heard the staircase they needed.
The blue arrow pointed straight at the wrong hiding place.
script: Jason said, The case is behind that wall. Lucia said, Why does your knock echo from above? He said, Thin rock. She said, No. Thin metal. Somebody covered the stairs with metal. Jason said, We pull it down. Lucia said, And advertise ourselves to whoever left that arrow? He said, We're already late. She said, Stop following the arrow and look where the dust hasn't settled. They lifted the chain. A counterweight raised the panel silently, revealing stairs to the ledge above their empty hiding place. Jason said, They moved it upstairs. Lucia said, They moved the sign downstairs. The case never left its shelf. Inside: cash, their original seal, and blue chalk. All three had waited inside the same case. Jason said, Next time, you knock. Lucia said, Next time, you listen before trying to knock down the mountain.
